summary: Bhushan confronts an arrogant group of village youths led by Bablu during a tense standoff in an open village field.

speakers.description: Villager wearing sunglasses and a headscarf, holding a rifle
Abhishek (Sachiv ji), young panchayat secretary in a grey Henley shirt
Bablu, cocky leader of the youth gang in a multi-colored button-up shirt
Bhushan (Banrakas), an outspoken middle-aged villager in a checkered shirt and sunglasses
Gang member in a green t-shirt with a checkered muffler
Gang member in a red-and-blue plaid shirt

relationships: Bhushan and his fellow villagers are confronting a defiant rival group of younger village men (Bablu and friends). Bhushan is senior in age.

lines.speaker: S3
lines.transcript: अब तो बेटा तुम दोनों का कच्छा भी उतारेंगे हम, ऐ!

lines.speaker: S4
lines.transcript: भाई, भाई, भाई, ऐ! भाई! ए बबलू कौन है रे?

lines.speaker: S4
lines.transcript: हं? तुम्हारे बाप का क्या नाम है?

lines.speaker: S4
lines.transcript: और कौन से गांव का है रे?

lines.speaker: S4
lines.transcript: आधार कार्ड नहीं बेटा, एक रहपट में हम सुधार कार्ड बना देंगे तुम्हारा!

lines.speaker: S6
lines.transcript: अरे ओ चाचा! ये वृद्धाश्रम जाने...

register_note: S4 addresses the young man dismissively with 'तू' (tu) and 'रे' (re) asserting seniority and dominance, while using sarcastic 'बेटा' (beta). Bablu retorts with cheeky sarcasm ('काहे आधार कार्ड बनाएंगे का?') and his gang disrespectfully calls Bhushan 'बुड्ढा' and mockingly 'चाचा'.
